title: Lauren Edit Response
description: What the edit-stage AI returns for a prompt. A follow-up prompt normally returns a patch: a list of operations on the current plan, addressed by item id. A full plan is returned for a first edit, or when a follow-up rebuilds most of the edit.

summary.description: What changed, in one or two sentences, written for the user. Becomes the plan's summary.

ops.description: Patch mode: operations applied in order.

plan.description: Full mode: the complete new edit plan (validated against edit-plan.schema.json).

position.description: Id of the item to place this one after, in the same collection. null places it first. Omitted places it last.

op.description: add: insert 'item' into 'to'. update: merge 'set' into the item 'id'. remove: delete the item 'id'. move: reorder the item 'id' within its collection.

id.description: update/remove/move: the target item. update also accepts "output" for the output settings.

to.description: add: the collection to insert into.

item.description: add: the new item, with a new unique id.

set.description: update: fields to change, as a JSON merge patch. Nested objects are merged, arrays are replaced whole, and null removes a field. A library reference with a different 'ref' replaces the old reference whole.
